guardianConsent.title: Parent or legal guardian consent
guardianConsent.intro: {{name}} created an account on LevApp, the platform padel coaches use to organise classes, attendance and messages with their students. Given {{name}}'s age and the rules of the country given, the account can only be used with the consent of someone holding parental responsibility.
guardianConsent.what: By consenting, you allow LevApp to process the data of {{name}}'s account — name, username, email, date of birth, country, classes, attendance, evaluations and messages with coaches — to provide the service, under the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service (version {{version}}).
guardianConsent.confirmMinor: I confirm the details above are correct.
guardianConsent.acceptTerms: I declare that I hold parental responsibility for {{name}} and accept, on {{name}}'s behalf, the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service.
guardianConsent.declineBody: {{name}}'s account and all of its data will be deleted right away. This cannot be undone.
guardianConsent.done: Consent recorded. {{name}} can now sign in to LevApp. We emailed you a link to withdraw consent whenever you want.
guardianConsent.declined: The account was deleted. We kept none of {{name}}'s data.
guardianConsent.expired: This link has expired or was replaced by a newer one. Ask for a new one.
guardianConsent.decided: This request has already been answered.
guardianConsent.failed: The answer could not be recorded. Try again.

guardianRevoke.title: Withdraw consent
guardianRevoke.body: Withdrawing consent deletes {{name}}'s account ({{username}}) and all of its data right away. This cannot be undone.
guardianRevoke.done: Consent withdrawn. The account was deleted.
guardianRevoke.expired: This link is no longer valid: consent has already been withdrawn.
guardianRevoke.failed: Consent could not be withdrawn. Try again.
